text:
Maya CS: Heads up — after three onboarding calls this week with high-touch accounts (NorthBridge, HelioCare, and StreamlineHR) I'm starting to see the same asks crop up. Capturing here before I add to the ticket queue.

Evan PM: Curious — are these feature asks or operational gaps? Short bullets please.

Maya CS: Quick bullets from call notes: 1) per-route cost breakdown on invoices (customers want to map costs back to product lines). 2) embeddings drift / staleness — searches returning outdated matches after weekly dataset updates. 3) CSV import column-mapping is brittle for complex schemas. 4) need a non-prod sandbox with realistic token quotas for QA.

Diego Support: Adding two concrete tickets: TKT-4921 (embedding staleness) and TKT-4978 (CSV mapping failures with nested fields). Both flagged as blocking for go-live on HelioCare and StreamlineHR.

Priya AE: Renewal note — NorthBridge renewal in ~6 weeks, they're already asking for per-route billing visibility before signing. Raising as a potential commercial blocker.

Jules Product: Thanks, Maya. Can you paste 1–2 verbatim customer quotes? Helps prioritize vs other backlog asks.

Maya CS: Quotes: "We need to show product owners which features drive the monthly bill — otherwise finance won't approve us." — NorthBridge.
"Our semantic search used to surface recent hires; now it returns old candidates from stale embeddings. It's making the team lose trust." — HelioCare.

Evan PM: OK. Quick triage from PM side: embedding-staleness feels like P0/P1 depending on root cause (infra vs. model refresh cadence). Per-route billing is P0 for accounts with near-term renewals. CSV mapping and sandbox are P2.

Maya CS: Agree, prioritize per-route billing for NorthBridge. HelioCare — we can likely mitigate with a one-off embedding refresh + doc-level TTL while product investigates.

Jules Product: Can @Diego or @Maya attach the support logs for TKT-4921 and the sample CSV for TKT-4978 into the product board card? I'll create cards if you want.

Diego Support: Uploaded logs + sample CSV to board card #PRD-1197. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRD-1197.

Maya CS: I've pinged account teams and PMs. Quick poll: which should we push as a short-cycle fix vs a roadmap item? React with :one: for per-route billing, :two: for embedding TTL/refresh, :three: for CSV mapping, :four: for sandbox.

cs-bot: Poll results in 24h: :one: x3, :two: x2, :three: x1, :four: x0

Evan PM: That's decisive — we'll scope a minimal per-route billing export (CSV + UI toggle) as hotfix (2 sprints) and a diagnostic plan for embeddings (investigate refresh cadence + cache TTL). Jules — want me to schedule a 30-min sync to sketch acceptance criteria?

Jules Product: Yes please. Evan, schedule with Maya + Diego + eng lead. I'll add acceptance criteria items to PRD-1197: invoice export format, mapping to product route ID, permission controls.

Priya AE: I'll note this in the NorthBridge renewal brief and ask for a quick validation call once the export prototype is ready.

Maya CS: Thanks all — will update the customer threads and post a follow-up here after the sync. :thumbsup:
